summary: Iter257 — Platform Earning Operating Expenses + Face Mismatch Alerts. Backend: 19/19 pytest cases pass (CRUD, meta, validation 422s, 401 gate, soft-delete, history, Net Profit integration into summary & trend, cache bust on mutation). Face mismatch sim prints 'first 1' / 'second (dedupe) None' and persists notification doc with correct title, link '/admin?tab=bookings&booking=<id>', data.event='face_mismatch', data.booking_code='AZPE100948'. Frontend (web_panel /admin?tab=platform_earning): all data-testids present and working — pe-expenses section, pe-add-expense opens pe-expense-dialog with pe-exp-date/amount/category/description/vendor/mode/reference/save/cancel; save disabled until required fields filled; pe-exp-row-0 renders; pe-exp-total shows ₹37,000; pe-exp-cat-'Rent & Office' bar rendered; pe-kpi-net-profit-value shows ₹33,276.01 (no longer 'not configured'); pe-pnl-net-profit ₹33,276.01, pe-pnl-net-margin 14.5%; pe-profit-toggle-net_profit toggle rendered; pe-exp-edit-0 opens dialog with pe-exp-history audit entries. notif-bell shows '9+', clicking opens dropdown with red-highlighted notif-item-face_mismatch (bg-red-50/70), clicking navigates to booking detail page which shows Face mismatch 91% confidence / 'SIMULATED mismatch' banner with Re-check action. Live SSE toast (red, 30s) code reviewed in PanelLayout.jsx NotificationBell — correctly emitted only from backend's own SSE process (sim script in separate process can't trigger it, as noted in spec).
critical_code_review_comments: platform_expense_routes.py uses pe._CACHE.clear() for cache bust — tightly coupled to service internals; consider a pe.invalidate_cache() helper for better encapsulation (minor).

pytest-xdist is enabled globally via pytest.ini addopts; this test file must be run with -o addopts='' because concurrent admin OTP logins revoke each other's sessions (device_revoked). Consider making admin token revocation respect a device_id so parallel test workers do not knock each other out, or add a shared conftest fixture that scopes auth to session.

Face mismatch dedupe is based solely on prev checkin.face_match.status == 'mismatch'. Re-running sim_face_mismatch.py resets status to 'unverified', so operators who legitimately re-check a flagged booking will re-notify. Spec says this is intentional; acceptable.
